For the Petitioner : Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate  Mr. Akhouri Awinash, Advocate For the State : Mr. Bishambhar Shastri, APP

For the Informant : Mr. Vikash Kumar, Advocate  ---------
04/ 09.08.2024 Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No. 50 of 2024 for the offences registered under Sections 377, 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner pointed out the contents of F.I.R and has submitted that as far as the allegation of Section 377 IPC is concerned that has been deliberately incorporated to make the offence more graver.
He further pointed out that petitioner is cousin brother of Jija of the informant and since out of love they got married and started residing under same roof.

He further brought to notice of this Court that petitioner has filed a divorce case against the informant and there is no scope for reconciliation at this stage as petitioner is behind the bar since 06.05.2024.
He also pointed out that chargesheet has already been submitted and petitioner is no more required for further investigation.

3. Learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant pointed out that the allegation levelled against the petitioner and submitted that allegations are serious in nature, as such,
petitioner should not be admitted to bail.
4.
This Court carefully gone through the contents of F.I.R and other materials available on record.

Considering the totality of aforesaid facts and circumstances especially the fact that chargesheet has already been submitted and petitioner is no more required for further investigation, this Court do find it a fit case for grant of bail to the petitioner.
The petitioner named above, is directed to be Ashish Prince vs The State Of Jharkhand .....
